desc: Ideation: choose B-bit sliding-window DP with fast-forward (rotation for A=B, threshold for A<B)
Implement the full Python solution using the B-bit state, merged bad-run validation, good-gap fast-forward threshold, and final reachability check
Verify the implementation on the three samples and edge cases: A=B, A=1, B=1, M=0, adjacent bad intervals, bad run length >= B, very large N/gaps, and state becoming zero
